tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequences and key physicochemical parameters of sC184b and its analogues.
footnotes: D-type amino acids are represented by lower-case letters (i: D-type Ile, i’: D-type Allo-Ile); homoarginine and ornithine are represented by letter Z and letter O, respectively.
The retention time (tR) on HPLC of each peptide was positively correlated with its hydrophobicity.

The hydrophobic moment of the peptide, which was positively correlated with its amphipathicity, was calculated via Heliquest (http://heliquest.ipmc.cnrs.fr/cgi-bin/ComputParams.py). Due to site limitations, the hydrophobic moment of the peptides containing unnatural amino acids cannot be calculated.
